tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0043", "detail": "Line 1 'Sabun Cuci Tangan 5L' is ordered at a PO unit price of 129200 for quantity 18."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "0582/INV/BSJ/IX/2026", "detail": "Line 1 bills 18 units at 137000 each (amount 2466000), i.e. 7800 per unit above the PO price."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-003#2.2", "detail": "Unit prices may change only by a written addendum signed by both parties and are not retroactive; no addendum sets a price for Sabun Cuci Tangan 5L."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-003#11.1", "detail": "The only price addendum (21 Aug 2026) concerns Cairan Pembersih Lantai 5L from 9 Oct 2026, not the line 1 item, so it cannot justify the higher price."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0043", "detail": "All 18 units of line 1 were received, so the quantity itself is not in dispute."}], "explanation": "Line 1 is invoiced at 137000 per unit against the PO price of 129200, and no contract addendum authorises that price for this item, so the excess 7800/unit is an unapproved overcharge."}]}
